job.job_description:
Job Summary

Software Developer - IIT Graduates
Build AI Products That Matter
Turium AI is building Algoreus, an enterprise AI platform that automates business processes using AI, workflows, and enterprise integrations.
We're looking for a talented Software Developer who is a graduate of an Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) and enjoys building modern applications, solving complex technical problems, and working with emerging AI technologies.
If you're excited about AI, scalable systems, and building products used by enterprise and government clients, we'd love to hear from you.


Responsibilities

Develop modern web applications using React.
Build mobile applications using React Native.
Develop backend services and APIs using Python.
Design and optimise relational databases.
Build and maintain ETL pipelines for data integration and transformation.
Integrate enterprise systems through APIs and data services.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
Troubleshoot production issues and optimise application performance.
Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and AI engineers.
Contribute to the development of AI-powered enterprise products.


Required Skills Qualifications

Bachelor's or master's degree from an Indian Institute of Technology (IIT).
2-5+ years of software development experience.
Strong experience with React.
Strong Python development skills.
Experience developing REST APIs.
Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
Experience designing and maintaining ETL/data migration processes.
Understanding of Git and modern software development practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Nice to Have

Experience with AI or Large Language Models (LLMs).
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Experience working with enterprise applications or ERP systems.
Knowledge of message queues, background jobs, or workflow engines.
Familiarity with data warehousing or analytics platforms.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
